notes: Tier 1 (direct HTTP) sufficient throughout. robots.txt at ae/en/robots.txt returned 404; global ikea.com/robots.txt has no Claude/Anthropic-specific disallow (checked for claude|anthropic|gptbot|ccbot), so no policy_opt_out. Fetched homepage HTML for /ae/en/ and /ae/ar/ (Arabic toggle) and extracted the embedded full site category-tree JSON (906 unique category ids, identical set in both locales -> confirms the tree, not just labels, was fully captured). Only ONE genuine seasonal node exists in that tree: id 49149, displayed as 'Holiday decoration' (Arabic: 'زينة العطلة', literal 'holiday/vacation decoration') but with URL slug 'christmas-decorations-49149' and page <title> 'Christmas Decorations: Holiday Decor UAE - IKEA' -> this is IKEA's generic-branded Christmas/winter-holiday decor hub, so classified under category=Christmas. It sits under the main 'Decoration' nav branch (visible, not hidden) and has exactly 3 child PLPs: Tree ornaments & accessories (49155), Winter candles & candle holders (49157), Winter table decorations (49156). Verified via IKEA's public product-list-page API (sik.search.blue.cdtapps.com/ae/en/product-list-page?category=<id>) that parent productCount=24 exactly equals the sum of the 3 children (3+7+14=24), confirming the parent is a pure grouping/union node -> kept as a grouping row (qty null, link null) per the no-double-count rule, with the 3 children as the real qty rows. Also found a second node, id 'wt001' title 'Winter Collections' (image path 'winter-holiday-wt001.jpeg', page <title> 'Winter Holiday Collection Online in UAE - IKEA', productCount=143) but it is flagged isHiddenNavigation:true in the source JSON (not exposed in the mega-menu/any visible nav path, no href to it anywhere on the homepage, and it is absent from robots-indexable sitemap discovery attempts which all 404'd). Sampled 30 of its 143 products via the same API: RINNIG tea towel, CYLINDER vase set, mugs, cutlery sets, aprons, rugs, frying pans, LED light chains, table settings, etc. -- ordinary general home/kitchen merchandise with no Christmas/holiday-specific framing beyond the internal 'winter-holiday' asset filename. This fails criterion 2 (site does not itself present it to shoppers as a holiday category; it reads as a seasonal-timing merchandising bucket, not a genuine customer-facing holiday PLP) and is not reachable via any visible taxonomy path, so it was EXCLUDED. Checked explicitly for Eid, Ramadan, Iftar, Diwali, Halloween, Valentine's Day, Easter, Thanksgiving, and New Year: none appear anywhere in the category-tree JSON (English or Arabic labels/slugs) or in the homepage campaigns list. As a secondary (non-authoritative) check, ran internal site search (search-result-page API) for each of those terms: 'valentine', 'thanksgiving', and 'iftar' returned 0 results (max=0); 'eid', 'ramadan', 'diwali', 'halloween', 'easter', 'new year' returned large nonzero 'max' counts (166-1578) but the actual returned items were unrelated generic products (e.g. 'eid' -> LINDBADEN slatted bed base; 'ramadan' -> GOKVALLA cushion cover; 'diwali' -> MORKULLA scented candle; 'new year' -> JATTEBO chaise longue module) with no relatedSearches/didYouMean hits -- classic no-match relevance-fallback behavior, not genuine tagged results, corroborating the absence already established from the category tree itself. No dedicated Eid/Ramadan hub exists on this AE storefront despite it being a Gulf/UAE market.
